decisions.reason: Strong external validation from the UK Home Office and 30 APIS schemes resolves uncertainty favorably, so the option is kept open with low withdrawal probability.
The cyber training module remains close to existing services and cheap to keep while its prospects are still uncertain, so it is retained as a low-cost option.
Behavior analysis still lacks clear validation but builds on established capabilities, making it a low-cost option worth holding for now.
The web platform has a dedicated page and fits verification services, so it is kept open while results continue to develop.
